legal.autoRenewApple: Auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple account when you confirm, and it renews at the end of each period unless you cancel at least 24 hours before. You can manage and cancel it in your Apple account settings.
legal.autoRenewGoogle: Auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Google Play account when you confirm, and it renews at the end of each period unless you cancel before. You can manage and cancel it in Google Play → Subscriptions.
legal.webNote: Secure payment with Stripe. No commitment: cancel whenever you like.

free.note: This will never be paid. If you leave Social, your zones stay on the map and searching works just the same.

privacy.title: Your location, no small print
privacy.location: While you use the app we store your position rounded to about 100 metres, so we know which alerts are yours. We don't follow you with the app closed, and nobody else sees where you are.
privacy.zones: In walking zones, only your friends see your name. Everyone else sees how many people are there, never who.

free.q: Do I have to pay to send an alert?
free.a: No. Alerts, notifications, the chat, pet profiles and the QR tag are free and will stay that way.

trial.a: When you sign up you get 30 days of Social without giving a card. When it ends, if you don't subscribe, you lose walking zones and friends, but searching works the same. You're never charged unless you ask to be.

cancel.q: Can I cancel whenever I want?
cancel.a: Yes, from {{store}}. If you cancel, you keep Social until the end of the period you've already paid for.

zones.q: What happens to my zones if I leave Social?
zones.a: They stay on the map for everyone. You get their social side back as soon as you turn Social on again, without losing anything.
